s.note: Metro City's best villain gets hungry too
s.how: Mix 200g shredded cooked chicken with 200g grated cheddar and mozzarella, 1 diced red capsicum, 2 sliced spring onions and half a teaspoon smoked paprika. Spread over half of each of 4 large flour tortillas and fold over. Cook in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and the cheese has melted. Cut each into 4 wedges and serve with tomato salsa and sour cream.

s.note: Minion, the fish in a robot suit
s.how: Rub 100g butter into 150g flour, then mix in 150g grated cheddar and a pinch of smoked paprika. Add cold water to bring together and chill 30 minutes. Roll thin, cut into fish and bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Serve in a round glass bowl.

m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, then add a can of crushed tomatoes, a spoon of cumin, 2 chopped chipotles and water to cover. Simmer for 3 hours, adding 2 cans of kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Serve with sour cream.

w.how: Whisk 250g flour, a spoon of cocoa, 150g sugar, an egg, 125ml oil, 250ml buttermilk and blue colouring to a smooth batter. Bake in cases at 175C for 18 minutes. Pipe with cream cheese beaten with icing sugar. Presentation is everything.

d.how: Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Put 2 scoops vanilla ice cream in each. Pour 300ml very cold cola slowly down the side of each glass, stopping to let the foam settle before topping up. Shave 30g dark chocolate over the foam with a peeler and serve straight away with a long spoon and a straw.
